aboutGame.title: Qu’est-ce que Sovereign Tower?
paragraphs: Sovereign Tower is a histoire-rich medieval gestion RPG where joueurs become the ruler of a magical tour. You recruit unique knights, assign quests, and make choix that shape your royaume.
The game combines royaume gestion, character relationships, and time manipulation mechanics. Players can rewrite decisions, discover secrets, and create different outcomes through multiple timelines.

items.question: Qu’est-ce que Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower is a medieval gestion RPG about ruling a magical tour, recruiting knights, assigning quests, and shaping royaume outcomes through histoire choix.

items.question: What should beginners do first in Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower beginners should learn how the Sovereign role works, recruit early knights, understand quest assignments, and watch how each decision changes royaume progress.

items.question: How do knights work in Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower knights are recruited characters who support royaume quests, histoire events, and Round Table decisions. Managing their roles and relationships is central to progression.

items.question: How do quests affect Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower quests drive histoire progression, royaume gestion, and character outcomes. Choices made during quests can open different paths and reveal new events.

items.question: Does Sovereign Tower have retour dans le temps mechanics?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower uses retour dans le temps choix so joueurs can revisit decisions, use knowledge from previous outcomes, and pursue stronger royaume results across timelines.

items.question: Where can joueurs get Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower is disponible on Steam for PC, with official game information and updates published through the Steam page and WILD WITS GAMES channels.
